key.answer_key: The panel shows that all of the PEG bands (C-O, C-C, CH2) are strongly attenuated in the 2% gel spectrum, not just the bands that would be expected to change if the crosslink formed specifically at C-S-Mo. Because the attenuation runs across the whole set of PEG bands rather than being localized to the crosslink-relevant vibrations, the spectrum on its own does not confirm the specific chemisorption/crosslink claim; it only shows a broad, non-selective loss of PEG signal in the gel.
